## Recommendations before translating the remaining library

1. Treat the book's `default_locale` edition as the source of truth for all structural (non-localized) fields; new translations should copy these fields verbatim rather than re-authoring them.

2. Add a CI check (this script, `--check` mode) to the translation batch workflow described in `docs/product/MULTILINGUAL_TRANSLATION_PILOT.md`, run after `compile_pack` + `build_manifest` + before `bundle_content_assets`.

3. Extend `lesson.json` schema validation (`schemas/lesson.json`) to reject structural-field drift between editions of the same `bookId` at compile time, not just at audit time.

4. Keep `featured` / ordering flags on the *book*, not per-edition, in a future manifest schema revision — today they must be manually kept in sync per edition.

5. Re-run this audit after resolving flagged items, then proceed with the remaining category batches from the pilot plan.
